item.title: 1996 Toyota Land Cruiser Prado KZJ95 Turbodiesel 5-Speed
item.description: This 1996 Toyota Land Cruiser Prado is a right-hand-drive example that was said to have imported from Japan to the US in November 2023. It wears a repaint in black over matching seat covers, and power is provided by a 3.0-liter 1KZ-TE turbodiesel inline-four linked with a five-speed manual transmission and a dual-range transfer case. item.title: Three-Decades-Family-Owned 1966 Ford Bronco Roadster
item.description: This 1966 Ford Bronco is one of 4,090 Roadsters produced in the inaugural model year and was acquired by the seller's father in 1989, with ownership passing to the seller in 2025. A refurbishment completed in the late 1990s included a rebuild of the replacement 289ci V8 as well as a repaint in red. The cabin is outfitted with fixed-back bucket seats, aftermarket gear levers, and an Alpine head unit linked to a custom sound system. item.title: 1970 Oldsmobile Toronado Custom
item.description: This 1970 Oldsmobile Toronado Custom remained with its original owner in California until 2023, when it was acquired by the selling dealer. Finished in Galleon Gold over white upholstery, the car is powered by a 455ci V8 linked with a three-speed automatic transaxle. Equipment includes a white vinyl roof, grille-mounted quad headlights, power steering, power-assisted front disc brakes, wheel covers, a split-folding front bench seat, power windows, air conditioning, and an AM radio. item.title: 2026 Porsche 911 GT3 Touring 6-Speed
item.description: This 2026 Porsche 911 GT3 Touring was delivered new to the Porsche Experience Center in Los Angeles, California, on January 14, 2026 and has 585 miles. item.title: 14k-Mile 2014 Audi R8 V10 Coupe 6-Speed at No Reserve
item.description: This 2014 Audi R8 V10 coupe is a Canadian-market example that was imported to the US by the selling dealer in October 2025.
